source.text: Assuming #MichaelBrown and #DorianJohnson were involved in robbery, when can we expect President Obama's apology to the #Ferguson PD? #tcot

selection_rule: Strict explicit stance only. Support means the comment accepts the source's pro-police/anti-Obama framing, treats Brown's alleged robbery or conduct as materially relevant, or defends the Ferguson police response. Oppose means the comment rejects the source framing, argues Obama need not apologize, emphasizes due process, excessive force, over-militarized policing, or that alleged robbery would not justify shooting.
note: Selected 30 explicit comments with balanced stances. Off-topic race-war side-thread comments, jokes, and ambiguous replies were excluded where possible.
